arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-01 Speed Chase.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-01 Speed Chase
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
Pursued by Ninety-Nine on a motorbike the group can only speed down the streets of Syndicate to escape. With Che driving Hecate and Hella speculate why the Legion is after them.
The argument and the escape are cut short by a swarm of gangsters fleeing in the opposite direction.
While fighting off the gangsters intent on seizing your car Hella is nearly hit by a grenade. Only a sudden command from the shackles allows her to dodge. While still cursing the Chief out her attitude has softened considerably.
Meanwhile Ninety-Nine and Legion members catch up with the group. While the Legion merely intents to kidnap Chief for their boss the enraged Ninety-Nine is set on murder.
Furious about her using the shackles on Hella she launches a deadly assault on Chief.
With the encirclement thrown in disarray the group takes the chance to escape by car once more.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-02 Highway Battle.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-02 Highway Battle
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
After the MBCC squad breaks trough their encircelment The Legion resorts to a shootout on the highway to disable the group escape vehicle. Hecate and Nightmare have to fend of the attack with Hella having to play bodyguard for Chief.

Hecate: No need. Your arms are too short, you can’t reach them.
Hella: Elegant Syndican language

Even with Hecates protection heavy weaponary eventually blows up the truck. Only in the last moment can Hella throw Chief to Nightmare before being blown up with the car.
With the vehicle destroyed the is surrounded once again by the Legion.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-03 Interception.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-03 Interception
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
With the car destroyed and Hella being trapped by the wreckage Hecate has to face The Legion assault on her own. While Hecate refuses an offer to join the Legion Hella crawls out of the wreckage. Furious over the drivers presumed death she kicks of the fight.
Just then Ninety-Nine joins the fray, only to be stopped by Hella. Before any more pursuers can catch up the unexpectedly alive Che snatches one of the Legions cars.
Only now, with Ninenty-Nines helmet destroyed, can Hella recognise her friend as the car speeds away.
Once again their escape is cut short by an ambush. This time it’s Zoya herself, sending the approaching car flying with a single punch. Their luck finally having run out, the group gets captured.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-03-RE Interrogation.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-03-RE Interrogation
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
Waking up inside a moving Legion truck, Chief finds herself confronted by Zoya, the leader of the Legion.  Zoya is well informed about Chief and the MBCC and immediately demands them to abandon their pursuit of the Sinner, one of her own crew.
From Zoya we learn that Chief is genuinely new in her role and even she has no idea about our background. Still she has enough access to know about the Shackles. Now she wants to get the details on how they work.
Chiefs refusal is rendered irrelevant when Earl cuts in via phone with the intel he gathered. While the MBCC themselves don’t know much about the Shackles, either, they do use three abilities of them to control Sinners.

Combat ability enhancement
Weak sense tracking
The Forbidden Force

Physical contact is required for the shackles to be established, but only the death of one either shackle wielder or Sinner can break the connection.


                  
                  Zoya 
                  
                

That’s why those geezers picked her… She surely makes a good slave.


The ability Zoya is most interested in is the corruption resistance the shackles provide.
Denying the involvement of Dr. Iron, she claims that the intel comes from an interrogation in one of the others vehicles.
A short while later the Legion Convoy arrives at a construction site sitting above an abandoned Crypt, the Mania from it is so intense Chief can vividly sense it from above. This is the place where the Inheritance lies.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-04 Shackles In Hostage.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-04 Shackles In Hostage
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
The Legion convoy arrives at the Crypt to claim the Inheritance. While the excavation site of the crypt is fortified by the remaining major Syndicate gangs Earl is more worried about the mania contamination inside the crypt. But Zoya forces the reluctant MBCC Chief to shackle her, so she can withstand the intense mania field. Only seeing Hecate and Hella threatened does Chief give in to her demands.
Wanting to test how the Shackles affect her abilities she throws a car at a group of gang members waiting in ambush and crushes them in a short fight. Hecate is worried about the side effects of shackling an S class Sinner, but Chief reassures her that this will work in their favour eventually.
Earl overhearing them tries to reason with them. The Legion is trying to unify Syndicate, so they don’t intend to make unnecessary enemies of the authorities. Seeing Chief reluctant to make a deal with the Sinner who interrogated Hecate and Hella, he resorts to the threat of his ability. Using a mania bomb inside Chiefs head as leverage Earl makes clear that he disapproves of this partnership and will terminate it permanently once she is no longer useful to Zoya.
Hella unsuccessfully tries to get information about Ninety-Nine out of Earl, but is cut short by Zoya giving the order to move out. Leaving Chief in a lose lose situation.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-05 Feast of Violence.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-05 Feast of Violence
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
While slowly advancing into the gang occupied building complex Earl gives Chief a short history lesson about the West District. The conversation is cut short by a contamination trap.
The trap was not set by Sinners, but by Thou Voodoo gang members wielding Mania Weapons. Coordinating with them against The Legion a group of Gonzales members flank the MBCC team.
Before reinforcements from the Red Falcon and Carnivore can join the fray they get taken out by Zoya and her Legionaries. To oppose Zoya the rival gangs unite for the first time, but that only gives the Legion the chance for a decisive strike.
Meanwhile Hecate is mostly worried about the unknown mania weapons the gangsters wield.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-06 Mania Weapon.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-06 Mania Weapon
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
While Zoya handles the gang ambush the MBCC team examines the Mania Weapon Thou Voodoo was using. A cane with a Mania Crystal embedded in it’s head.
Earl helpfully gives some background. These weapons are used by Syndicate gangs to imitate the power of Sinners. The more bloodthirsty the wielder, the stronger the Mania power. The user themselves are only subject to mild contamination, since the majority of it is inflicted on the victim.
Meanwhile the Red Falcon members demonstrate the effect of this property. Shooting at The Legion and their allied Gonzales at the same time they turn the gang members into Corruptors to slow down the advance of the Legionaries.
With Zoya rushing after the Red Falcon, her troops are getting cornered by Corruptors. Picking a fight with Hella Earl conscripts the team to hold the rear for the Legion.
After the Corruptors are dealt with the remaining gang members have scattered into small groups, making them a hassle to deal with. Earl leaves the team behind for a mop up operation. Chief promptly uses the opportunity to draw out some of the smarter gangsters that Earl warned them about. Soon a group of Yagyu members show up.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-07 Proposal.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-07 Proposal
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
Luring out the Yagyu gang members, Chief pretends to be a newbie Sheriff working with Ted that got taken by The Legion after the battle at SALVA Hospital.
Thinking he landed an intelligence windfall the Yagyu Executive offers Chief an alliance. Revealing that the gang alliance set up a trap for Zoya in the underground levels and that Chiefs target, the Legion Sinner who escaped from SALVA is already trapped half dead underground, too.
The Yagyu offer to hide Chief from the Legion by staging a kidnapping, so Earl won’t have a reason to set off the bomb. Seeing Chief as a valuable talent for training Sinners, as evidenced by Hella and Hecate. Yagyu is training young Sinners as obedient child soldiers, like the Gray-haired Girl they sold to Ted. Apparently Ted was a pioneer in brainwashing and abusing kids.
To Yagyu young Sinners are but superior versions of mania weapons. An enraged Chief confronts the Executive about just wanting her Sinners. Having reached her limits the team drops the deception.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-08 Struggle of the Abandoned.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-08 Struggle of the Abandoned
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
Realising Chief played them, the Yagyu Executive calls for his allies from Thou Voodoo and Carnivore that lie in wait, all armed with Mania Weapon. Losing his composure he shows clear signs of Mania contamination.
The overuse of Potestas and the close proximity of the Inheritance cause Chief to lose focus. Hecate urges Hella to evacuate her, while she holds of the enemy. But both Hella and Chief are vehemently against the plan, making Chief flat our order Hecate to stay at their side.
Getting cornered by the combined reinforcements of the allied gangs the MBCC team fulfilled their role as bait. After crushing the Red Falcon detachment baiting her, Zoya and her subordinates attack the now concentrated gang forces.
Faced by her overwhelming power the Yagyu executive begs for his life, claiming he was forced into the gang by circumstances. But his extravagant sword is proof that he killed scores of people to get his position. He pledges his loyalty to her as the new overlord of Syndicate in a final bid to save his life.
But Zoya doesn’t want to rule Syndicate, she wants to crush it and every single gang member along with it.


                  
                  Zoya 
                  
                

I don’t want to be your king. I want your death.


Having killed her prey out of fury, she commands her Legionaries to grill the remaining members for info on the situation before killing them, too.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-09 Script of The Weak.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-09 Script of The Weak
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
Reaching the central elevator to the underground levels Zoya plans to only take the MBCC team with her, leaving Earl and her underlings to destroy the massive arsenal of Mania Weapon stashed at the elevator.
Chief uses the sudden ambush of Red Falcon gangsters, who detonate the stored mania weapons as a chance to get away from Zoya.
The plan is simple, intentional get taken as hostage by one of the surviving Yagyu members. Zoya refuses to intervene and Chief gets dragged away into a hidden passage.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-10 Sense.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-10 Sense
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
While Chief is lying on the ground as the obedient hostage, waiting for her Sinners to get to the warehouse the remaining gang members are looking for a way out of the situation.
Red Falcon wants to abandon the plan, Yagyu wants to use the hostage and Thou Voodoo wants to to use the Inheritance. They can’t go back on the plan, since the client for this gig are them, their suppliers of Mania Weapon. Probably the Underground trough Parma.


                  
                  Yagyu Remnanat 
                  
                

This is a job from them, and your only option is to get it done! We must destroy the Legion!
And don’t forget the weapons, the weapons they gave us! Mora and stronger Mania weapons!


The gang members decide to head to the Inheritance via a second elevator with their hostage in tow. But Chief provokes the frustrated Yagyu gang member into attacking her to delay long enough for her team to get here.
Hecate is visibly upset at Chief for getting beaten up, even Hella is furious at the state she is in. After venting their anger on the gang members the girls deliver first aid to Chief.


                  
                  Hecate 
                  
                

Just like Chief can locate Sinners with the shackles, we can sense your presence too.


Hecate tracked down Chief by the shackle connection.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-11 Crystal.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-11 Crystal
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
With Zoya being underground and Chief temporarily safe Hecate proposes to return to the MBCC to remove Earls bomb. But Chief wants to continue the search for Subject R and find clues about the Inheritance and the producer of the Mania Weapon.
One of the weapon containers also holds a jar filled with a blood red liquid.


                  
                  Label 
                  
                

PARMA-Type 99


Hella recognises it, not a mania crystal extracted from a Sinners body, but a product of the experiments she had undergone. Before Chief can ask questions the mania fluid reacts with the Inheritance to produce countless contamination spikes from underground. The floor gives way and the team finds itself in a cellar filled with more P marked weapon crates. All leaking their contamination as well.
Even though she’s worried for Ninety-Nine, Hella is forced to face the Corruptors born from the contamination first.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/03 Unclaimed Crypt A/03-12 Type-99.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.title: 03-12 Type-99
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/03.content:
Disregarding Hecate calling for a retreat Hella rushes ahead into a concealed laboratory filled with more Type-99 marked jars. Shattered by another pulse from the Inheritance their contamination pools together and forms a polymer in the form of Ninety-Nine.
The sight of her friend leaves Hella absolutely shocked. Parma used 99 as a cultivation medium for the mania crystals forged into Mania Weapon.
The mania weapon enable their wielder to use the power of the Sinner they were extracted from. Hella wants revenge on those responsible for torturing her, 99 and the other Sinners, but can only vent her rage on the walls.
The influence of the Inheritance not only caused the mania crystals to go manic, even the elevator shaft itself is filled with contamination. To prevent an even worse calamity Chief decides to press on despite the danger.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-01 To The Abyss.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-01 To The Abyss
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
Descending on the elevator into the depths of the Crypt the team has to fight off Corruptors as the elevator gets stuck on contamination crystals.
During the attack some enemies resort to severing the elevator cable sending it crushing down.
Coordinated and targeted actions like these should be beyond Corruptors, something else is clearly going on.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-02 Weightless.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-02 Weightless
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
With the elevator rapidly descending down the shaft enemies can only chase from above. Hecate speculates that someone is controlling the Corruptors as explanation for their abnormal behaviour.
Finally the mad descent ends with the elevator crushing into the bottom of the shaft. Thanks to the contaminating spikes melting along the way the resulting sludge acted as a buffer, leaving the team only with minor injuries.
According to Hecates analysis the Corruptors have been turned a long time ago. But unlike the basement of SALVA Hospital, where the contamination resonated with the Gray-haired Girl, the Mania contamination here seems to originate from the Inheritance.


                  
                  Chief 
                  
                

You can sense a strong presence ahead of you, throbbing slowly in the bowels of the crypt. It is radiating strong and murderous malice, nothing human like.
It’s more like a bewitchment, a curse that goes back a long way to the source.


Assured by Hella that her injuries won’t be a problem the team hurries into the depths. Zoya is coming down the central elevator shaft and they have to beat her to the Inheritance.
Chiefs wonders why only a narrow passage has opened in the spikes as if welcoming someone. It was neither Hellas nor Hecates power that melted the spikes.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-03 Message.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-03 Message
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
The passage show clear signs of recent fighting. Gang members unsuccessfully tried to stop Zoyas missing subordinate from going deeper.


                  
                  Hella about Horo 
                  
                

It was only one person. How insanely powerful… The brutal way they fought does look a lot like Zoya. I bet they must be a demon bear, a demon bear with a huge ax at that.


Horo left a message on the tunnel wall, mystifying Hella who can’t read. “Downward, be careful”. A torn first aid bandage from SALVA Hospital speaks both of her wounds and to her identity as the Sinner who escaped from SALVA. Even though the fighting style is completely different from what you’ve seen of Subject R.
Revived by the contamination the dead Corruptors once again launch an abnormal attack on the team to prevent their descent.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-04 Contaminated Passage.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-04 Contaminated Passage
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
The Inheritance is resonating with both the Corruptors and the Mania Weapon bringing forth extremely powerful contamination.
Fighting their way to the exit of the passageway Nightmare brings down the ceiling blocking out the Corruptors. Before them is a pit nearly 100 meters in diameter, a path spirals down to a floating island at the centre.
The Inheritance lies there, inside a stone alter in the very middle of the island.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-05 Abyssal Sarcophagus.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-05 Abyssal Sarcophagus
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
With the Inheritance being displayed so openly the team discusses if it’s a trap or a requirement to store it in the first place. Since the altar shows strange marking pointing to some ritual use.
With Subject R nowhere in sight and Zoya closing in the group starts it descent, but is immediately ambushed by Horo. To the astonishment of Hella, the assailant is a girl her age and height.


                  
                  Hella 
                  
                

… How come the Master of Axes is so tiny? How old is she?


Horos fighting style is very reminiscent of Zoya herself making her difficult to deal with.  Hecate plans to corner the Mania stricken Horo long enough for Chief to put the Shackles on her. But Chief resorts to deception instead, claiming to be with The Legion. Mercenaries send down to save her.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-06 Deception.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-06 Deception
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
To convince Horo Chief slightly twists the story, so that instead of the MBCC they were with SALVA Hospital and The Legion all along. Send down to rescue Horo by Earl after Zoya went down trough the trapped central elevator.
The mention of, her brother, Earl being concerned for her finally sells the story to her.  To make up for attacking you she throws herself into the fight against the approaching Corruptors. To Hellas great bemusement the proud girl proclaims herself a honourable fighter and immediately asks you to accompany her to Zoya.
Chief trying to convince her to head to the Inheritance first leads to a tantrum, but her brutal injuries finally catch up with her as she collapses. Not only the fresh wounds, the fight also opened up the old wounds SALVA had provisionally treated, confirming that she is indeed the Sinner they have been chasing. Deciding against shackling her, the team takes her with them as they go deeper into the cavern.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-07 Questioning.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-07 Questioning
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
Carrying Horo on her back Chief begins to question the young Sinner that had just come to again.
At the beginning of N.F.112 Horo was lured into a police office and arrested. When they found out she was a Sinner they transferred her to MBCC where she was for about half a year. She wasn’t involved in the MBCC Riot, just too advantage of it to escape.
While Horo was detained by the Public Security Bureau she overheard a conversation.


                  
                  Horo 
                  
                

He said… The Inheritance in the Rust has been moved, to a disused pit in the southern desert… It continues to produce forces… and they have to deal with The Legion as soon as possible…


That’s why she escaped and went straight to the Crypt to verify the intelligence. There she saw someone experimenting on humans at the Stone Altar, trying to create Mania Crystal.
While the Researcher was afraid the Legion would come for them before they were ready, Parma suggested to use the Inheritance itself to take them out. With the gangs themselves as bait and fuel for the Inheritance.


                  
                  Parma 
                  
                

The Inheritance exists for the sole purpose of granting wishes.


Unfortunately Horo was discovered and gravely wounded, but was rescued by Crache. Crache came here in search of green haired gambler, a little kid about her age, presumablyRoulecca, that came here for revenge. Finding the near death Sinner instead she brought her to SALVA Hospital, where Dr. Iron managed to save her life.
The whole rumour of a MBCC escapee stealing a mania inducing power was born from Horo trying to gather intelligence on the Inheritance. As Hella summaries, it becomes clear that this was never a lead to Subject R, just bad intel. But as Hecate points out, finding out the truth about the Inheritance is also their job. So they have to continue regardless, even if Chief is struck by the revelation that she risked her life for a false lead.
Barely beating back the contamination the dispirited team gets a lecture from the recently awoken Horo. The Inheritance is being activated again, if it’s not stopped, everyone is going to die. There is no time for second thoughts.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-08 Legion Commander.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-08 Legion Commander
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
Bickering with Hella about Zoya gets Horo to open up about her commander. Before they became The Legion they were a mercenary fleet, taking commissions and avoiding fights.
They lacked the strength to take on the injustice they encountered and experienced. Earl invited Zoya to increase their fighting power, shattering Horos self confidence.
Trying to prove herself Horo picked fights with gangsters and duelled Zoya. On one such excursion she got infected by Mania. Seeking one last fight she challenged Zoya again, who beat her into the ground before encouraging her not to give up.
Horo came out of that ordeal as a Sinner and with boundless admiration for her boss.
Horo picks up Chiefs unease about willingness to follow Zoya anywhere right away. But to her Chief is exactly the type of person that Zoya would like.
The heart to hearts gets interrupted by a ragtag bunch of mania addled gang members that caught up with the team.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-09 Trap.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-09 Trap
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
The gang members are using guns embedded with Mania Crystals, causing contamination to spread rapidly trough Horos arm from a bullet wound. Way faster than it normally would.
Both the Mania field and the contamination of Mania Weapon are being amplified by the activation of the Inheritance. Sludge is visibly oozing out from the stone altar and the ground is shaking.
Already contaminated by Mania the gang members believe the Inheritance on their side, a benevolent gift from the patron to take on The Legion and become the true masters of West District. But it is all a lie, they are just fuel for the Inheritance, but even more the whole battle for supremacy is a farce. Organised by the arms dealers behind the scene, the true masters of the West District.
But to the gang members only the power of the Inheritance is important, a power they want in their possession at any cost. Even the danger of getting corrupted is getting twisted into a chance to become a powerful Sinner. Power is everything for gangs of Syndicate.
The more frenzied the gang members become the more alive the Inheritance, almost like a beating heart. Hella is starting to hear voices in her head and Hecate is terrified for Chief who experiences it as if hands were tearing at her very soul. Stunned they can’t stop the gang members from rushing the altar, causing Horo to spring into action. On the verge of going manic she throws herself into the fight.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-10 Meet Again.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-10 Meet Again
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
Fighting the gang members Horo loses herself, her Mania getting out of control. The Inheritance resonates with the Mania around it, activating and strengthening it. In return Maniacs and Sinner losing control furthers the awakening of the Inheritance. A positive feedback loop that will end in disaster. The mastermind behind the Mania Weapon used gang members for this very purpose, creating a trap to cultivate the Inheritance.
Nearing her limit Horo is looking more and more like a demon than a person. Seeing the girl on verge of turning into a Corruptor, Chief is getting flashbacks to the Gray-haired Girl they couldn’t save. Swearing that this time, they will save her.
But the battle is only interrupted when a body smashes into the altar, thrown across the pit with the force of a canon ball. The frightening aura of an S class Sinner freezes everyone in place. Zoya has arrived.
Snapped out of their daze the gang members throw everything they have at her, but to no avail. The battle has ended, but the Mania is still looking for release, prey to vent Anger on.


                  
                  Vague Voice in your head 
                  
                

…So powerful… I want it… I want her… Come to me…


The Inheritance is trying to ensnare Zoya, but it’s Horo who embraces her before she can reach the altar.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-10-RE Bewitchment.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-10-RE Bewitchment
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
Upon being reunited with Zoya Horo tells her how much she looks up to her, that she guarded the altar sure her boss would come. But the Inheritance uses that wish to tempt Zoya into taking up the the eldritch power for herself. To use it to destroy Syndicate and create a new home.
Immobilised by the contamination the team can only watch. But Zoya just asks the manic girl, before punching her with full force.


                  
                  Zoya 
                  
                

You got yourself all the cuts and bruises… It isn’t just about its power, is it?
Horo, what do you fear?


Freed from the control for the moment, Horo blurts out that the Inheritance itself is what she fears. How she can’t resist its control, how it turns Sinners into monsters in an instant.


                  
                  Horo 
                  
                

This is the source, the source of Mania, the source of us.


Horo is ready to sacrifice anything to prevent her commander falling. Not only her, she is sick of seeing other sacrifice themselves to protect her.
This heartfelt genuine wish makes Zoya hesitate for a moment, giving the Inheritance the chance to sprout tentacles and reach for Zoya.
Finally Chief finds the strength to use the Shackles on Zoya, leaving her furious.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-11 Shackles Sinner.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-11 Shackles Sinner
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
Chief using the Shackles to restrict Zoya terrifies Hecate and Hella. But Earl’s mania bomb doesn’t explode, apparently he has to manually trigger it. The relief is short lived though.
Under the influence of the Inheritance the Shackles begin to weaken, it urges Zoya to break free and devour Chief. Zoya accuses her of wanting to use the Inheritance herself, but is rebuffed by Chief.


                  
                  Chief 
                  
                

There is something that I can’t forgive, so I have to fight it.
Mania has brought about countless misfortunes. No one should be allowed to use it to make bigger disasters. I dread it.


As Horo predicted earlier, Zoya applauds her backbone and integrity.
Contamination takes on the form of Horo and tries to straggle Chief, demanding Zoyas release. Watching her struggle to hold on Zoya makes her choice and joins the fray at Chiefs side. No longer restrained but enhanced by the Shackles Zoya destroys the contamination capturing the team in seconds.
Carrying the team and Horo to safety, Zoya admires Chiefs courage. Horo, writhing in agony is finally freed from the control of the Inheritance, collapsing into Zoyas arms.
Confident that Horo will make it trough this, Zoya turns her attention to the altar.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-12 The Dark Feast.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-12 The Dark Feast
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
Far from being under control the awakening Inheritance draws the gang members Zoya defeated on her way down to it. Frenzied to reach it, the gang members have been thoroughly contaminated by their Mania Weapon. While Hecate still tries to figure out why, the gang members are pierced trough by contamination spikes and sucked into the coffin.


                  
                  Vague Voice 
                  
                

Almost there… Ring… Almost there…


The coffins opens to reveal a withered hand raising up, mesmerising Chief . A scene that feels as familiar to her as it is nauseating. But the hand had already turned into a giant monster, terrifying Chief to the bone. They can’t let it get out into the chaotic Syndicate.
But Zoya is just bemused, reassuring her that she came prepared.
Even with the monster destroyed, the Mania does not dissipate and the voice does not vanish either.


                  
                  Vague Voice 
                  
                

Die.. Die! Ring… Ring… Almost there…
Give it back, give her back to me…


In the effort to trap Zoya with its tentacles the Inheritance reveals a burning red core, the true Inheritance. Protecting by the invigorated Shackles Zoya rams a blinding white light directly into the core sealing the core into a White Cube.
The shackles didn’t react at all to the white light, it was not Zoyas power.  Hecate confirms that it is an external seal, trapping the Inheritance alongside the Mania contamination.
With the altar in ruins and bereft of the Inheritances mania field even the Mania Crystals crumble. Earl makes his way down, collecting his unconscious sister along the way.
Announcing their victory, Zoya leads everyone back to the surface.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.filePath: Arcs/Blood & Iron/Unclaimed Crypt/04 Unclaimed Crypt B/04-12-RE It will be a blaze of fire next time.md
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.title: 04-12-RE It will be a blaze of fire next time
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/04.content:
At The Legion base camp the team can finally reach MBCC after 47 hours without contact.
Nightingale starts an investigation into the Inheritance and arranges a pick up for the team.
Three hours before the arranged time Chief has a final talk with Zoya. Amused at her indignation about Earl’s bomb, Zoya informs Chief that his ability only lasts for 24 hours.
To her surprise Chiefs learns that Earl and Horo are siblings, with his little sister still unconscious Earl will be absent for now. Even with the decontamination the corruption caused by the Inheritance got in deep.
With the lead to Subject R being dead now, Chief is determined to root out the conspiracy behind the Inheritance. But Zoya warns her, she already lost someone close that tried to investigate. To her there is no hope for Syndicate, even if they get the mastermind, the seeds have already taken root long ago. A statement that leaves Chief very concerned that Zoya might still aim to destroy it all.
But Nightingales arrives ahead of schedule, visibly relieved her Chief is safe. She clarifies to Zoya that MBCC is not here to apprehend Legion members. As a show of gratitude she only brought along minimal guards. After MBCC submitted the preliminary report to the city, the Public Security Bureau requested a meeting with Zoya to discuss the Inheritance and the future of the West District Management Regulations.
Though sceptical Zoya agrees to a meeting, while she keeps hold of the sealed Inheritance.
After the MBCC helicopter left, Che comes out of hiding to collect payment from Earl for intel provided. The reason he helped the team escape was to spy on them during the escape.
Earl is curious why the price is uncharacteristically low. Bai Yi lost the White Cube and K.K. in the operation. But Che only deflects the question, the cube was meant to used for this and one employees less is also one paycheck less, even asking for a good review for Whitestone Industries. With Earl clearly buying none of it, Che reveals that K.K. is gonna be safer with MBCC. While they managed to seal the Inheritance, this is just the beginning.
Still bothered by Subject R, Chief decides to stay in Syndicate until the negotiation is over, while Nightingale finds out who fed them bad intel.
Ready to move on the Legion sets the Crypt on fire, destroying all Mania Weapon and Mania Crystals. Horo and the retrieved documents are brought into a safe house. Zoya is determined to follow up on the lead Horo risked her life for. To finally change Syndicate.

arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/in.title: Unclaimed Crypt
arcs/blood--and--iron/unclaimed-crypt/in.content:
The MBCC team gets drawn into the conflict between Organisations/Gangs/The Legion and the Locations/DisCity/West District/West District gang alliance backed by Parma. With the support of corrupt PSB brass Parma established a Mania Weapon factory in the Rust which was moved into the Crypt in early N.F. 112.
Using an Inheritance at its core the facility refined Mania Crystals extracted from Sinners into Mania Weapons.
By chance the Legion Sinner Horo overheard officers involved in the conspiracy while in PSB custody. When Subject R staged the MBCC Riot in August N.F. 112 Horo used the chance to escape and sent word to her commander Zoya. Mortally wounded while infiltrating the Crypt she was rescued by Characters/DisCity/Inner Bay/Crache and brought to SALVA Hospital. From where she later escaped to protect the Inheritance until Zoya could come.
With the Crypt guarded by an alliance of all major Syndicate gangs (Yagyu, Organisations/Gangs/Red Falcon, Gonzales, Carnivore and Organisations/Gangs/Thou Voodoo) and the lower levels severely contaminated by the Inheritance Zoya was in dire need of reliable protection. Trough her connections to Whitestone Industries she acquired a White Cube to seal the Inheritance and intel about Chief.
Finding herself kidnapped by the Legion, forced to put her Shackles on Zoya and threatened with an implanted mania bomb by Earl, Chief stages her own kidnapping by Yagyu to get away. Together with Hella and Hecate she discovers that Parma has been experimenting on Ninety-Nine, Hellas friend, to produce advanced mania weapon. In a race against Zoya and the gangs to reach the Inheritance first they encounter Horo trapped in the lower levels.
Both parties eventually reach the Inheritance. But the whole incident was a maliciously designed trap. The gang members and stashed Mania Weapons were only fuel to awaken the Inheritance. With Zoya as the final piece to create a Black Ring.
Teaming up with the MBCC Zoya manages to resists the temptation of power and seals the Inheritance in the White Cube.
The PSB reacts to the preliminary MBCC report Nightingale submitted by offering talks about the West District Management Regulations to Zoya herself. With the lead to Subject R cold, thanks to the bad intel that made them track Horo instead, Chief decides to stay in Syndicate until the talks are finished.

arcs/precarious-polis/shattered-blade/in.content:

characters/discity/syndicate/salva/dr.-b.title: Dr. Brand
characters/discity/syndicate/salva/dr.-b.content:
A doctor at SALVA Hospital. In N.F. 112 he led an ambulance into Locations/DisCity/West District/West District to treat Maniacs among the gang members. Unfortunately they got into conflict with Ted and the Organisations/Security Forces/MBCC squad searching for Subject R.
He was interrogated by Ted who threatened his wounded colleague, Laura. Distraught by her pain and desperately wanting to save her he shared the little he knew about a Sinner being brought in by Anne and the absence of Dr. Iron.
When the party left he was seen desperately treating Laura, while crying over her dying body.
Stricken with grief and anger he succumbed to Mania and when he made it back to the Hospital he finally transformed into a Corruptor and attacked the ones who had hurt his friends. He died in battle with Chief, Hella and Hecate.

characters/discity/syndicate/salva/dr.-i.title: Dr. Iron
characters/discity/syndicate/salva/dr.-i.content:
Background 
                  
                

Born into a prestigious medical family in Eastside, Iron graduates from Organisations/Academia/Banyan Medical College as a neurosurgeon. She refused all offers and went to treat Mania in Locations/DisCity/West District/West District.
While she kept contact with Zoya and Organisations/Gangs/The Legion she established a truly neutral clinic not beholden to any gang.
During her duties she became infected with Mania as well. At a dark point it was only Anne, herself suffering from the infection begging her for help that gave her a reason to live on.
To treat her she cut off her own arm to slow the spread of the infection, awakening her as a Sinner.


Medical director of SALVA Hospital

characters/discity/syndicate/salva/laura.title: Laura
characters/discity/syndicate/salva/laura.content:
A nurse working at SALVA Hospital. She got injured when Ted and the MBCC team fought with her medical team. Ted shoots her several times while she is lying on the ground to gather intelligence from Dr. Brand.
Even after gaining the intelligence Ted tried to kill her, but was stopped by Hecate. But despite the doctors best efforts she died from her grievous injuries.

characters/discity/syndicate/ted.title: Ted
characters/discity/syndicate/ted.content:
Background
Leader of a small gang in Syndicate. Is quite well recognised by other gangs, but not respected.
He lost his eye and got infected by Mania in a gang fight, but was treated by Dr. Iron. Along with the artificial eye came the inability to use a Mania Crystal. Denied the power of Mania he developed a burning hatred for Sinners. Fearing their powers but also desiring it.
Descent into Darkness
When he bought a young Sinner from Yagyu he and his gang abused and tortured her. Trying to break her into total obedience.
To take revenge on Iron he made a deal with an unnamed group for Mania Crystals and Underground mania technology. In return he would track down the Inheritance and a fugitive Sinner for them. Since the group also hates the MBCC it’s very likely that he made contact with an actual underground agent or a direct proxy.
Attack on Salva
By becoming an informant for the Public Security Bureau Ted learned about Chief tracking down a fugitive Sinner in Syndicate. Staging a foiled assassination attempt, by the young Sinner he brutalised, he inserted himself into the manhunt. Shooting his own Sinner had the dual purpose of baiting the SALVA doctors to bring her into the heavily fortified SALVA Hospital.
Ted soon showed his psychopathic side by torturing Laura, Anne and Dr. Brand and turning his own gang members into Maniacs. His assault on SALVA proved fruitless when neither the inheritance nor the Sinner were in the hospital. When the young Sinner went manic he fled from the scene, planning to launch a second assault to destroy SALVA and kill Chief.
Demise
But both his flight and plans where cut short when he run into Dr. Iron. Last time he was seen he was mindlessly smiling at Irons feet after being lobotomised by her.

characters/paradeisos/rri/lemma-herzfeld.title: Lemma Herzfeld
characters/paradeisos/rri/lemma-herzfeld.content:
Lemma Herzfeld is a scientist at the Ring Research Institute, heading the BR003 Observation Hub. Born in NF 98/99 she was selected by the Heterogeneous Trial program and received training in Paradeisos under the mentorship of EDGE 02.
In May NF 113 she was appointed to the EDGE 07 seat after the High Tower black ring broke out. 36 months into her tenure she was removed from her seat by EDGE 02 and Director Isomer. A few days later she reclaimed her seat with the assistance of SHP-13, Summer and her researcher team. By her demand she became the designated EDGE 02 backup and took over the Heterogeneous Trial project.
Her research team was known as the Mania Dimension Core Research Team. She has been with the team since N.F. 112. Her specialisation is Mania analysis and application across multiple domains, with particular focus on theoretical research in Mania dimensions.

characters/paradeisos/rri/sarah.title: Sarah
characters/paradeisos/rri/sarah.content: Born in N.F. 100/101 she joined the Mania Dimension Core Research Team in N.F. 113. Her speciality are Dimensional superposition experiments. She is responsible for experimental procedure design, equipment calibration and technical verification.

incidents/black-rings/br005.content: Orchestrated in the Outlands by Fraser and the Underground. incidents/dissea-expedition/contact-lost.title: Contact lost with Expedition
incidents/dissea-expedition/contact-lost.content: All contact with the Expedition was lost. Presumably because they entered the inner death zone around the town of Maria.

incidents/dissea-explosion.title: DisSea explosion
incidents/dissea-explosion.content:
In N.F. 84.12.22 an explosion occurred in the DisSea region. Spreading Mania across the city. The initial explosion resulted in at least 97,231 Maniacs.
The incident was the first public Mania crisis, which led to the formation of the FAC. But there are only very limited information available about it.

incidents/edge-signing.title: E.D.G.E. Signing
incidents/edge-signing.content:
The Exploration, Defence and Governance Entente was drafted by a group of visionaries lead by Keylan. It established DisCity as a mining city on the shores of DisSea. The city would mine and export Hypercubes and receive goods and other supports from the city states.
One after another the surviving city states joined the Entente.

incidents/eclipse-operation.title: Eclipse Operation
incidents/eclipse-operation.content: A raid into DisSea and even further into BR000 itself. All mobilised FAC squads died during the operation. It was considered a failure and lead to a severe backlash against FAC itself.

incidents/keylans-death.title: Keylans Death
incidents/keylans-death.content: Dr. Keylan died of illness. DisCity build the Keylan Square in the West District and erected a statue in memory of the man who brought hope back into the world.

incidents/outland-wars/edge-contact.title: EDGE Contact
incidents/outland-wars/edge-contact.content: The white sands guerrillas make contact with EDGE scientist Helena and the newly arrived EDGE intern. Securing covert support for their actions from the EDGE lab in Nirvana Port.

interrogations/hella-interrogation-first.title: Hella Interrogation first draft
interrogations/hella-interrogation-first.content:
Phase 1
Required evidence:

Public Security Bureau Record
Parma Report II
S-098 Arrest Report
As with most interrogations, we start with Hella in said interrogation room, on the chair. She is startled by the bright lights that turn on when the interrogation starts, and Chief immediately offers to turn them down. Hella refuses, stating their purpose to be intimidation, then challenges chief’s experience. Chief can either be sympathetic or cold, but Hella will interpret is as part of the “good cop-bad cop” routine. it’s now evident that she is not in a good mood. She brings up her file in the Public Security Bureau, which prompts the use of the first evidence.

Public Security Bureau Record
From N.F.100 to N.F.109 Hella is has in her criminal record 26 thefts, 25 scams, 5 kidnappings and 15 prison breaks. The notes of two PSB officers are also present, badmouthing her and noting her panache for using sympathy towards her as a weapon. Chief is not fond of the file. She notes that nowhere in said file are Hella’s powers explained, being captured and injured making her come across as weak girl instead.
Asking about the inconsistency, Hella explains that she wasn’t born a Sinner. She mocks the predictable following questions, noting they’ve been asked before. Weather Chief choses to ask anyways in a gentle or harsh tone, Hella instead goads them into presenting the second piece of evidence.
S-098 Arrest Report
This file documents Hella’s arrest in N.F.112. Medical examination reveals signs of experiments for more then three years, which matches with Hella’s absent criminal record from N.F.109 to N.F.111. As such, the FAC suspects Hella to be an artificially created Sinner. To that, Hella feigns ignorance, bringing up her lack of education as an excuse. This prompts the use of the last piece of evidence.
Parma Report II

locations/discity/west-district/crypt.title: Crypt
locations/discity/west-district/crypt.content: Formerly a remote desert warehouse for the West District export trade. It was forgotten after the West District got abandoned. It’s remote location protected it from being destroyed in gang wars. But in August N.F. 112 it was occupied by a gang coalition and severely contaminated by an Inheritance hidden in its underground layers.

locations/discity/west-district/keylan-s.title: Keylan Square
locations/discity/west-district/keylan-s.content:
Statue of Keylan
A memorial to Keylan, who discovered the Hypercube Discovery and founded DisCity on the shore of DisSea to mine Hypercubes.

locations/discity/west-district/index.title: West District
locations/discity/west-district/index.content: The West District was DisCities industrial centre and the main hub for hypercube mining and processing. But most mines were destroyed in the DisSea explosion and the West District subsequently abandoned by the rest of the city. The separation was formalised by the West District Management Regulations in N.F. 99 and the now gang ruled district became known as Syndicate.

locations/dissea/index.title: DisSea
locations/dissea/index.content:
An inland sea formed in the impact crater of the Perishing Star. DisCity was established at it’s shore to mine Hypercubes. After the DisSea explosion revealing BR000 mining operations were severely compromised.
To contain the contamination the Broken Frontline was established.

topics/mania/mania-weapon.title: Mania Weapon
topics/mania/mania-weapon.content:
Mania Weapons as a general term can refer to any weapon utilising mania, like the Rancor. But Parma developed a way to mass produce powerful mania weapons utilising Mania Crystals harvested by torturing Sinners.
The design is based on Summers Ring Weapon research at the Organisations/Academia/Ring Research Institute, which was leaked to Parma in N.F. 111 by Laplace.
But the raw materials for producing them were sourced by the Underground from N.F. 103 to 108.
